author: Epic Games
description:
Story Pack 1: Mad Ellie and the Vault of the Damned is now available! Play as an all-new Vault Hunter, C4SH the Rogue, and team up with Ellie in a cosmic-horror adventure across the new Whispering Glacier map zone. 

Buy now: https://epic.gm/borderlands4-pack1

As the first Story Pack addition to Borderlands 4, Mad Ellie and the Vault of the Damned features the most amount of new content in a Borderlands 4 DLC so far:  
► New Vault Hunter C4SH the Rogue, playable across all of Borderlands 4's base game and DLC zones  
► New map zone, The Whispering Glacier, packed with new story missions, side missions, activities, and collectibles  
► Two new major boss fights, 16 minibosses, and new enemy types  ► 3 Pearlescent weapons and 11 new pieces of Legendary loot including weapons, gear, and Class Mods  
► 28 new cosmetic items

Borderlands 4 is a mayhem-fueled looter shooter, jam-packed with billions of weapons, outrageous enemies, and intense co-op action. Explore a dangerous hidden planet
title: Borderlands 4 | Story Pack 1: Mad Ellie and the Vault of the Damned | Launch Trailer

author: Epic Games
description:
Return to the Vesper Relay in Warframe's latest update, The Shadowgrapher! Though long-destroyed, a strange painting that hangs in its ruins has beckoned to the Arbiters of Hexis, prompting you to investigate. Visit the Relay and enter the canvas of chaos that lies within to illuminate a mystery long lost to the shadows…

You'll also meet the 64th Warframe, Follie, an inkblot-based artistic maestro who bends reality and controls enemy crowds with her myriad sketches and tricks. Joining her are the latest incarnations of the Origin System's favorite odd couple: Gauss Moto and Grendel Turbis. With full suites of mecha-inspired Customizations, the rapid meets the ravenous like you've never seen before.  

Our first standalone update of 2026 also expands and improves your overall Warframe experience with the addition of the new Follie's Hunt game mode and numerous quality-of-life improvements including (but not limited to): legacy Quest updates, fresh faces for your Operator and Drifter,
title: Warframe | The Shadowgrapher Official Gameplay Trailer | Available Now!
